questions.prompt: What is the emergency number in New Zealand for immediate danger?
questions.feedback: Use the local emergency number elsewhere and verify current guidance.

questions.prompt: What is outside the course's scope?
questions.answer: Individual danger assessment, personalised safety planning, diagnosis and treatment.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only. Use answer-specific feedback and delayed retest.
scoring.practice: Chooses safe, proportionate follow-through and distinguishes ordinary disagreement, organisational support, specialist help and emergencies.
scoring.transfer: Complete the boundary scripts capstone with safe ordinary requests, refusals and follow-through, plus a contrasting case requiring organisational or specialist support. Distinguish emergency assistance from routine support and explain why the plan cannot determine individual safety.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
